# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 36 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** God's Judgment on Adam: Mercy

---

**1** God said to Adam: 'I have forgiven you. I am the Lord your God who made you from the earth.'

**2** 'In my mercy I will give you rest from all toil and pain.'

**3** Adam said: 'Lord, I thank you for your great mercy. Blessed is your holy name forever.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
